what: The lab asks the reader to remove the & from Die& die and look at the dice report. With seed 105 the game then loops forever, and no report is ever printed.
evidence:
Lab 5.2: "Remove the & from Die& die in play_turn's parameter list. Play ./bust 105. What happens to the dice report, and why?" Scratch run of bust.cpp with play_turn(const Player& p, Die die) and printf 'Ada
r
b
r

what: Panel 16's terminal shows the 'merged' stream, which capture.py records from a second run of `cmake --build build`. By then the library and main.cpp.o were already built, so the page lacks the compile and pack lines that the readers' first build prints, and its percentages differ from the recorded stdout.
evidence: data/cpp-ch17.json nolink.cpp step 1: stdout has "[ 25%] Building CXX object ...kitchen.cpp.o / [ 50%] Linking CXX static library libkitchen.a / [ 50%] Built target kitchen / [ 75%] Building CXX object ...main.cpp.o / [100%] Linking CXX executable app", but merged starts "[ 50%] Built target kitchen\n[ 75%] Linking CXX executable app\n/usr/bin/ld: ...". comic.js line 246 shows merged when present. ex-nolink says "The library compiles and packs fine", and panel 16 says "Read it from the top", yet the shown run has no compile lines. This is the only merged stream across ch16–18 whose lines differ from stdout+stderr (script check).
fix: Make nolink a session .cmd whose build step prints with 2>&1 on the first run (so no separate merged re-run is needed), or add a hidden `rm -rf build/CMakeFiles/*.dir` before the re-run. Engine-wide: capture merged in the same run (see INTEGRATION_TODO 'merged is a separate run').

what: The Debug run shows only the assertion. The program's two lines before it ("Debug build: asserts are on duty" and "2 soups, 1 pie: 1100 cents") are missing because stdout was a pipe and abort() threw away the buffer. A reader running it in a terminal sees those lines, and the page never explains the difference.
evidence: modes_debug.cpp lines 13 and 15 print before the line 16 call that aborts. Captured ./build-debug/modes: stdout '' , stderr "modes: .../main.cpp:5: int bill_cents(int, int): Assertion `soups >= 0 && pies >= 0' failed. / Aborted", exit 134. Panel 19's Wren only says "the bad bill stops with exit 134". grep 'buffer' in ch17.html: 0 hits. (ch16's spot_next exercise does explain the same effect.)
fix: Add a sentence under the DEBUG terminal: "Its first two lines never appear here: they were still waiting in std::cout's buffer when abort stopped the program. In a terminal you'd see them." Or end those prints with std::endl / write them to std::cerr and recapture.

what: The page says REQUIRED turns a quiet 'not found' into an error, but without REQUIRED CMake still prints the same long CMake Warning. It isn't quiet.
evidence: Readlist: "REQUIRED made the missing package an error instead of a quiet \"not found\"." Scratch run with CMake 3.28.3 of find_package(fmt) without REQUIRED: "CMake Warning at CMakeLists.txt:3 (find_package): By not providing \"Findfmt.cmake\" ...", then fmt_FOUND=0, and configure continues.
fix: "REQUIRED made the missing package an error that stops configure; without it you'd get the same text as a warning, and the build would fail later at fmt::fmt."

what: Exit code 127 is attributed to the shell, but here it comes from the dynamic loader. The shell's 127 means 'command not found', and the command was found.
evidence: Linker bubble: "Exit code 127 is the shell's \"couldn't start that\"." Captured: "./build/app: error while loading shared libraries: libkitchen.so: cannot open shared object file", exit 127. ld.so prints that line and exits with 127 itself.
fix: "Exit code 127 is the loader giving up before main."
